confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Phuket price levels, not checked against live listings. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by location and season. Prices are set for July, which is low season, so accommodation is estimated at the lower end. FX: the 0.6955 figure (15 Oct 2026) comes from a search result that attributes it to the RBA Exchange Rates Overview. I did not open the RBA page to confirm it, and I did not use a 16 Oct figure from a third-party site.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Thai resort destinations (Koh Samui, Pattaya, Chiang Mai) and Southeast Asian beach-tourism cities, adjusted for Phuket's July green-season discount and a THB/USD conversion of roughly 32 to 34 THB per USD.
